suburban life: After years in a noisy city apartment, my parents now enjoy suburban life with a quiet garden and friendly neighbors.
在吵雜的城市公寓住了多年之後，我父母現在享受著郊區生活，有安靜的花園和友善的鄰居。
a suburban area: We moved to a suburban area outside Taipei, where the houses are bigger but the trip to work is longer.
我們搬到台北外圍的一個郊區，那裡的房子比較大，但上班的路程比較長。
suburban sprawl: Suburban sprawl has turned the farmland around the city into endless rows of houses, shopping malls, and parking lots.
郊區無序擴張已經把城市周圍的農地變成一排排無盡的房屋、購物中心和停車場。
suburban values: The novel makes fun of suburban values, such as owning a big house, a nice car, and a perfect lawn.
這本小說嘲諷郊區中產階級價值觀，例如擁有大房子、好車子和完美的草坪。
be sufficient for: Will one bottle of water be sufficient for a three-hour hike on such a hot summer day?
在這麼炎熱的夏天，一瓶水足夠走三小時的健行嗎？
sufficient evidence: The police let the man go because there was not sufficient evidence to prove that he had stolen the car.
警方放了那名男子，因為沒有充分的證據能證明他偷了那輛車。
a sufficient condition: In math class, we learned that being a square is a sufficient condition for a shape to be a rectangle.
在數學課上，我們學到「是正方形」是一個圖形成為長方形的充分條件。
sufficient funds: The bank refused my payment because my account did not have sufficient funds to pay the bill.
銀行拒絕了我的付款，因為我的帳戶沒有足夠的資金支付這筆帳單。
self-sufficient: The family grows its own vegetables and uses solar power, so they are almost completely self-sufficient.
這家人自己種菜並使用太陽能，所以他們幾乎完全自給自足。
a superb performance: The young pianist gave a superb performance last night, and the audience stood up and clapped for five minutes.
那位年輕鋼琴家昨晚帶來一場精彩的表演，觀眾起立鼓掌了五分鐘。
superb quality: This restaurant uses fresh local fish of superb quality, which is why its sushi is so expensive.
這家餐廳使用品質極佳的新鮮在地魚貨，這就是它的壽司那麼貴的原因。
in superb condition: Although the car is twenty years old, it is still in superb condition because its owner takes great care of it.
雖然這輛車已經二十年了，它仍然狀況極佳，因為車主非常細心地保養它。
be superior to: Many reviewers say the new phone's camera is superior to last year's model, especially when taking photos at night.
許多評論家說，這款新手機的相機優於去年的機型，尤其是在夜間拍照時。
superior quality: Their handmade shoes cost more, but customers keep buying them for their superior quality, which is clearly better than cheaper brands.
他們的手工鞋比較貴，但顧客因為它們的優質而持續購買，品質明顯比便宜的品牌好。
a superior smile: When I made a mistake in class, the top student gave me a superior smile, as if she were much smarter.
當我在課堂上犯錯時，那位第一名的學生對我露出高傲的微笑，彷彿她聰明得多。
superior numbers: The soldiers fought bravely, but the enemy's superior numbers allowed them to surround the town and win the battle.
士兵們英勇作戰，但敵軍人數上的優勢讓他們得以包圍城鎮並贏得戰役。
superior strength: Thanks to his superior strength, the older wrestler easily pushed his smaller opponent out of the ring.
憑藉更強的實力，那位年長的摔角選手輕鬆地把體型較小的對手推出場外。
the Supreme Court: The case went all the way to the Supreme Court, whose final decision cannot be changed by any other court.
這個案子一路打到最高法院，它的最終判決是其他任何法院都無法更改的。
make the supreme sacrifice: Every year we honor the brave soldiers who were willing to make the supreme sacrifice to protect our country.
每年我們都向那些願意犧牲生命來保衛國家的英勇士兵致敬。
supreme confidence: She walked onto the stage with supreme confidence, sure that she would win first prize again this year.
她帶著十足的信心走上舞台，確信自己今年會再次贏得第一名。
reign supreme: For over ten years, this team has continued to reign supreme in the league, winning almost every championship.
十多年來，這支球隊持續稱霸聯盟，幾乎贏得每一座冠軍。
of supreme importance: For pilots, safety is of supreme importance, so they check every part of the plane before each flight.
對飛行員來說，安全至關重要，所以他們每次飛行前都會檢查飛機的每個部分。
the supreme commander: As the supreme commander of the army, the general made the final decision about when the attack would begin.
身為軍隊的最高統帥，這位將軍對攻擊何時開始做出最終決定。
a trade surplus: Because the country exports far more goods than it imports, it has enjoyed a trade surplus for many years.
因為這個國家出口的貨物遠多於進口，它已經享有貿易順差許多年了。
surplus food: Instead of throwing it away, the supermarket gives its surplus food to local charities at the end of each day.
這家超市沒有把剩餘食物丟掉，而是在每天結束時把它們送給當地的慈善機構。
a budget surplus: After cutting costs and collecting more taxes, the city government finally had a budget surplus this year.
在削減開支並徵收更多稅金之後，市政府今年終於有了預算盈餘。
surplus to requirements: When the factory bought new machines, the old ones became surplus to requirements and were sold at low prices.
當工廠買了新機器後，舊機器就變得多餘、不再需要，並以低價賣出。
a suspect package: The train station was closed for an hour after someone found a suspect package left under a bench.
有人發現一個被留在長椅下的可疑包裹後，火車站關閉了一個小時。
suspect motives: Many voters questioned the politician's suspect motives when he suddenly gave money to schools right before the election.
當這位政治人物在選舉前夕突然捐錢給學校時，許多選民質疑他可疑的動機。
His evidence is suspect: His evidence is suspect because he changed his story three times, so the judge does not trust it at all.
他的證據可疑，因為他改了三次說法，所以法官完全不相信。
